title: P-link1: JoinLinkPolicy.join_link decodes as Uri
description: room-policy-04 §6.2 types JoinLinkPolicy.join_link as opaque<V>; decision mimid-1wgh.3.21 says it carries the request URI and empty means none. Chosen: decode as the crate's Uri (same wire bytes): non-empty values must be RFC 3986 syntax (mimid-1wgh.36), empty = absent.
